title: TaskFrame: Connecting Task-Level Planning with Frame-Level Control for Game Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.40276v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Building general game agents requires both high-level task reasoning and low-latency action control in rapidly changing visual environments. These capabilities favor models with substantially different computational profiles, making them difficult to realize within a single model. In this work, we present TaskFrame, a hierarchical planner-controller framework that connects task-level planning with frame-level keyboard-and-mouse control. A vision-language task planner decomposes a high-level goal into an ordered sequence of atomic instructions and is optimized through supervised learning and dependency-aware GRPO. The hidden states of special goal tokens that terminate each atomic instruction provide continuous goal embeddings that are cached and reused across control steps. translated_title: TaskFrame：连接任务级规划与帧级控制的游戏智能体框架
translated_abstract: 构建通用游戏智能体需要在快速变化的视觉环境中同时具备高层任务推理能力和低延迟动作控制能力。这两种能力所偏好的模型计算特性差异巨大，因此难以在单一模型中实现。在本工作中，我们提出了TaskFrame，这是一个将任务级规划与帧级键盘鼠标控制相连接的层次化规划器-控制器框架。视觉-语言任务规划器将高层目标分解为有序的原子指令序列，并通过监督学习和依赖感知的GRPO进行优化。终止每个原子指令的特殊目标token的隐藏状态提供了连续的目标嵌入，这些嵌入会被缓存并在控制步骤间复用。因果Transformer控制器将当前活跃目标的嵌入与最近的观测相结合，以预测离散的键盘和鼠标按键动作以及连续的…（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: TaskFrame提出了一种层次化规划器-控制器框架，由视觉-语言规划器将高层目标分解为原子指令并生成可缓存复用的目标嵌入，再由因果Transformer控制器结合这些嵌入与实时观测实现帧级键盘鼠标控制，从而在游戏智能体中兼顾高层任务推理与低延迟动作控制。
en_tdlr: TaskFrame is a hierarchical planner-controller framework that bridges task-level planning and frame-level keyboard-and-mouse control, where a vision-language planner decomposes high-level goals into atomic instructions with cached, reusable goal embeddings, and a causal Transformer controller combines these embeddings with recent observations to enable low-latency action prediction for general game agents.
